name: 文本人味化
description: 基于宿主 LLM 的文本润色模块，将生硬、模板化或过度 AI 感的文字改写成更自然、可读、适合手机屏幕的表达。
description_en: LLM-backed text humanizer that rewrites stiff, templated, or AI-sounding copy into natural, readable mobile-friendly language.

apis.name: humanizeText
apis.desc: 调用宿主 LLM 改写文本，可指定风格、受众、语言和保真要求
apis.desc_en: Rewrite text through the host LLM with style, audience, language, and meaning-preservation controls
paramDesc: 是否严格保留原意，默认 true
paramDesc_en: Whether to preserve meaning strictly, default true

apis.name: makeNatural
apis.desc: humanizeText 的便捷别名，默认输出自然口语化文本
apis.desc_en: Convenience alias of humanizeText for natural conversational rewriting

apis.name: scoreText
apis.desc: 不调用 LLM，给文本做可读性和模板化倾向的本地粗评
apis.desc_en: Local heuristic readability and templated-copy scoring without LLM

apis.name: openPage
apis.desc: 打开文本人味化界面并返回 _openModule 信号
apis.desc_en: Open Humanizer UI and return _openModule signal
